Overview

Hachioji is a city in with a population of 579,000. A western Tokyo hub surrounded by mountains, known for its universities, hiking trails, and balanced urban-nature lifestyle. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
